title: avenula bromoides subsp. arundana
intro: Avenula bromoides subsp. arundana, commonly known as False Oat-grass, is a plant species in the grass family (Poaceae). It is a perennial grass that has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and support respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of False Oat-grass include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms such as coughing and bronchitis. The plant contains bioactive constituents including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
